name: LTX-2.5
notes: Open weights (gated) released 2026-08-11. ComfyUI v0.32.0 day-one native support. Minimum 16 GB VRAM (within RTX 5060 Ti budget). New Diffusion Fidelity Rendering, multi-shot, 4K, synchronized audio. Adds 4 new core nodes: LTXVSTGGuider, LTXVModalityGuider, LTXVDualCFGGuider, LTXVDurationPredictor. Current LTX-Video 2.x backbone is superseded. Post-release fix for float64 dtype device bug landed after v0.32.0 tag — verify against master before wiring.

name: Wan 2.2 Animate-2 (Wan2.2-Animate-2-14B)
notes: Released 2026-08-07, Apache-2.0. 14B DiT; end-to-end animation without intermediate motion extractor modules. ComfyUI adds WanAnimate2ToVideo + WanAnimate2Cache nodes. Better identity preservation and text-driven viewpoint decoupling. Current builder uses WanAnimateToVideo — node rename + weight swap required. May need new builder method or in-place upgrade.

name: Qwen-Image-Edit-2511
notes: Released 2025-12-23 (older than 7 days), but ComfyUI NATIVE support (TextEncodeQwenImageEditPlus path, not API partner node) confirmed active 2026-08-07. Supersedes current 2509 backbone. Same node graph — pure weight-file swap. GGUF Q8 fits 16 GB (~9-11 GB VRAM). Full fp16 needs ~45 GB. Improves: 1-3 image editing, identity/product consistency, advanced text editing, native ControlNet maps. Apache-2.0.
already_known_note: 2511 model released Dec 2025; newly relevant because ComfyUI native node support confirmed this week.

name: Grok Imagine Image 2.0 (xAI)
notes: Released 2026-08-07. ComfyUI v0.32.0 has partner API node. Currently #2 on Image Edit Arena (Elo 1439). No open weights — cloud API only. Magic-wand region edits, 5-ref-image support, Smart Resize. Monitor for open-weight release. Could add new build_grok_imagine builder if API node proves useful for spellcaster workflows.

name: ByteDance SeeDance 2.5
notes: Released 2026-07-31 (13 days ago). ComfyUI partner API node added 2026-08-07. No open weights — API-only. 30-second one-shot video generation. No local deployment. Monitor for open-weight release; if released, would target video builder family or new build_seedance_video.

name: Qwen-Image 3.0 Pro
notes: GA 2026-08-05. ComfyUI partner API node added in v0.32.0 (Aug 11). Ultra-long prompts (4,500 tokens); dense text-heavy layouts; 12 languages. No open weights for local deployment — cloud API only. Not viable for RTX 5060 Ti local run. Monitor; could add build_qwen_txt2img if API node proves useful.

name: WAN 2.7
notes: Open weights available under Apache-2.0 since March 2026 (~150 days ago). Not new this week. Better quality than WAN 2.2. WAN 2.6 was commercial-only. WAN 3.0 in early beta (no open weights). Monitor for a planned upgrade pass; mark as already-known.
already_known_note: Released March 2026; not new this week. Include as low-priority upgrade backlog item.
